validity_findings.description: Producer C1 (null_control) uses build_state_history_records K=2 (history_kind=state) while C3 uses build_action_history_records K=3 (history_kind=action). spec.json measurement_validity bullet 6 defines both Z forms but does not bind C1 to K; prereg section 5.1 per-alpha analysis step 3 says 'Run 500 within-session shuffled-action permutations, compute null_mean' without K tag. Mixing K inflates interpretive ambiguity: monotonic tradeoff is qualitatively robust but quantitative |null_mean| threshold crossing at 0.1 could differ between K2 and K3 due to different n_strata (1438 vs 841) and bias. Recomputation of raw_results.json confirms C1 values are K2-derived (null_control.observed equals k2_value_stochastic for each alpha). No evidence that K3 null would pass at any other alpha, but fix requires reporting both.

B-DETERMINISTIC-SPA control expected <0.1 bits but observed 1.391 (alpha=0),1.294 (0.01),0.773 (0.1),0.239 (0.5),0.109 (1.0). Failure is systematic and alpha-monotonic, not random. Root cause is identifiability: deterministic chooser uses prev1,prev2 state history not conditioned in Z. Thus I(Y;A|Z) !=0 by construction for K3 action-history conditioning. Baseline expectation is invalid for this design; control pass=false is correct observation but misframes as estimator bias rather than design gap.

Measurement is on sparse regime: K3 has 841 strata for 5000 records (avg 1.48 per (z,a) cell with n_a=4), K2 has 1438 strata (avg ~0.87 per (z,a) cell). Stratum_size_bias_decomposition shows only 380 strata with >=5 records (26.4% of K2 strata), below frozen MEASUREMENT_INVALID threshold of 30%. Null bias 0.924 at alpha=0 reflects high variance in tiny strata (0*log(0) skipped, empty cells contribute 0). This is disclosed qualitatively but not quantitatively against decision_rule clause 4. Verdict priority FALSIFIED > MEASUREMENT_INVALID means FALSIFIED still governs, but sparsity explains why MLE null is inflated and must be carried forward.

Producer correctly did not execute Phase2 bootstrap (K3-K2 CI) or N=50000 convergence because both_passers=[]; phase2=null in raw_results.json and validity_notes state bootstrap CI not computed. This matches frozen decision_rule Phase2 gating 'only if SURVIVES on C1'. No violation, but explicit null is appropriate.

Within-session shuffle implementation preserves session structure, state sequence and url_before/url_after pairing, recomputes plug-in KL on shuffled data with same alpha. Corrects parent global-shuffle deviation identified in prior audit V5. 500 permutations for C1, 1000 for positive_control_p, seed 42 deterministic. Small null_std (0.000149 at alpha=1.0 to 0.009312 at alpha=0) confirms tight null distribution. Procedure matches frozen null_control description.

Design verification passes: 48/48 (state,action) pairs have 4 distinct candidates, same CANDIDATES as parent EXP-PHYSICS-35482477045. N=5000 (50 sessions x100 steps) stochastic (sha8cff7c33...) and deterministic (sha46ed606a...) datasets deterministic with seed 42. K3 determinism ratio 77/841=9.16% and K2 366/1438=25.4% confirm stochastic mixing 0.5 produces substantial non-determinism and environment can express CMI beyond Markov. Sampling correct.

Frozen decision_rule priority FALSIFIED > MEASUREMENT_INVALID > SURVIVES applied correctly. C1 not triggered because not all alphas fail (alpha=1.0 passes |0.064|<0.1). C3 triggered because alphas passing C1 ([1.0]) have positive_control_k3 0.098876 <0.5 bits (best and only). C6 pass. Therefore verdict FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING via C3 is valid. Outcome FALSIFIES (H0) is consistent.

claim_ceiling: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING survives only at this bounded ceiling: plug-in KL estimator D_KL(P(Y|Z,A)||P(Y|Z)) with Laplace smoothing alpha in {0,0.01,0.1,0.5,1.0}, computed with MIN_STRATUM_SIZE=5, on the synthetic stochastic 12-state 4-candidate hash SPA (50% deterministic hash over prev1,prev2,current,action +50% uniform over CANDIDATES[current][action], true I(Y;A|Z)~1.52 bits), at N=5000 (50 sessions x100 steps, seed 42, STATES and CANDIDATES frozen from parent), with within-session action-label shuffle null (500 permutations for C1, 1000 for C3), cannot achieve both |null_mean|<0.1 bits and K3>=0.5 bits with p<=0.001 — tradeoff is monotonic and irreconcilable (no crossover). Sensitivity increases 13.9x (0.099->1.377) while |null_mean| increases ~14.4x (0.064->0.924) as alpha decreases. This falsifies only the hyperparameter-tuned plug-in KL pathway on this discrete sparse-data SPA class (avg 1.48 records per (z,a) cell for K3). No inference warranted to: production Web transitions, larger N (e.g., 50000), richer state representations (DOM, accessibility tree, embeddings), continuous or larger-vocabulary spaces, alternative estimators (histogram, Bayesian, likelihood-ratio, corrected KSG), or different null frameworks. C-WEB-DYNAMICS remains HYPOTHESIS; C-MEAS-VALID for this estimator class is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING.
